balm:
Balm is a library mod for mod developers that simplifies the process of creating multi-loader mods by providing common interfaces and events and removing the need for most mod-loader specific code.

It is not a magic solution for running Forge and Fabric mods together. As a user, you only need to install this mod if you use a mod that requires it.

Versions for Minecraft 1.16 and below are not needed - mods will run without Balm on those versions!

 Key Points 

- No custom Gradle tooling, official mod loader plugins only
- Uses Mojang Mappings, supports Jared's Multiloader-Template
- All-inclusive from networking to configs, no third party dependencies
- Battle-tested across Blay's 20+ mods ranging from content additions to quality of life utilities
- Supports NeoForge and Fabric without duplicate code
- Snapshot builds for pre-releases and release candidates
- Unified support for Third
embeddium:
Embeddium

Embeddium is a free and open-source performance mod for Minecraft clients. It is based on the last FOSS-licensed version of the Sodium codebase, and includes additional bugfixes & features for better mod compatibility.

Despite being forked from Sodium, Embeddium is not supported by CaffeineMC . Do not report issues encountered with it to their bug tracker or in their Discord.

 Highlights

 All performance improvements from Sodium 0.5.8 and earlier, i.e. a rewritten terrain renderer, various optimizations to the immediate-mode rendering pipeline (used by entities, GUIs, block entities, etc.), and other miscellaneous improvements
 Available for Minecraft Forge on 1.20.1 and older, Fabric on 1.20.1-1.20.6, and NeoForge on 1.20.1 and newer
 Integrated Fabric Rendering API support (Indium is no longer required, and will not work with Embeddium)
 Frequent patch updates to fix mod

ixeris:
Ixeris

 Overview

Ixeris is a mod that optimizes event polling to improve client performance.

You might have noticed a visible drop of the FPS when you move your mouse. Part of the FPS drop is because the game does have additional jobs to do when you turn the camera, like calculating the visibility of chunks. However, because of the inefficiency in the native code that polls events and the JNI upcall overhead, some of the CPU time, otherwize can be utilized for rendering, are unnecessarily spent on event polling. This is most noticeable on Windows, especially when your mouse has a high polling rate.

Ixeris resolves the issue mainly through two measures:

- Threaded Event Polling . Instead of performing rendering and event polling on the same thread, Ixeris performs event polling on the main thread and kicks rendering to a separate render thread .
- Buffered Raw Input (Windows-only). S

boat-break-fix:
BBF stays true to the vanilla boat's behaviour, which "works as intended" according to Mojang. This is only a hotfix to prevent accidental deaths. 

 

 Boat Break Fix is a simple mod that fixes the annoying bug where if you fall from a distance equivalent to 12, 13, 49, 51, 111, 114, 198, 202, 310, or 315 blocks with a boat, it'll break on landing, and you will recieve the equivalent fall damage.

Not to be confused with the Boat Fall mod, which does the opposite of BBF. (Enables fall damage using boats)
 

This mod just fixes that, while also increasing boat performance as less code is running on each tick, and yes, the mod does work with unlimited world heights.

In case you want to know which specific heights are affected in vanilla, you can use f(n) = (25n^2 ± n)/2 where n is an integer.

A small mod that runs all calculations of the railway network on a separate thread parallel to the server tick, which greatly improves performance, especially in large networks.

This mod is server-side only, but it can also be used on the client-side (if you are playing in singleplayer).

This mod works with Create 0.5.1 and all Create 6 versions!

Since this mod offloads all train calculations to a separate thread, problems can arise with addons that rely on or modify these parts of Create's code. UniMixins

UniMixins is a Mixin loader for Minecraft 1.7.10 (with partial 1.8.9~1.12.2 support) designed for maximum compatibility. It aims to combine the features of as many mixin loaders as possible, and its modular nature makes it possible to use along other loaders if desired.

 Background

Numerous Mixin loaders exist for 1.7.10, and each one provides a differing set of extra features we refer to as "extras" on top of providing Mixin.

Since each of these loaders is monolithic, different ones cannot be used at the same time due to unavoidable feature overlap. To avoid this problem, UniMixins offers each feature as a separate module (but a combined jar is still provided for convenience).

clear-void:
Clear Void
=====

 Sponsor if you like this project.

This is a simple mod that removes the pitch black bottom half of the skybox. You will probably need this if you are playing in some sort of floating island world.

Effect
-----

In vanilla Minecraft, when playing floating-islands worlds, you'll find that the bottom half of the skybox (the void) suddenly turning black when you go through Y=58. This is annoying in floating island worlds.

 

With the mod, the void will no longer suddenly turn black. Instead, it will gardually become dark when you go through Y levels below Y=-32.

 Actually it will, but at 64 blocks below the min build height, so you will not encounter it unless you are dying in the void. 

Reporting bugs
-----

Report bugs at Github Issue Tracker. Avoid using private messages since I might not check them.

World Play Time Reborn
 

 
---
World Play Time Reborn is a Fabric and NeoForge mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 and later that displays the amount of time you've spent on a given Minecraft world and its save-directory size in the world selection screen, in the top-right corner of each world entry. It does this by checking the "Play Time" statistic for the world, so playtime will be displayed for existing worlds that were created without the mod as well.  The mod is client-side only, and does nothing on the server-side.

This mod is a fork of Spice of Life: Sweet Potato Edition , designed to reward players with numerous benefits for cooking large, hearty meals, and disincentivize cheesing the system with low effort foods. 

 Sweet Potato Edition (and the Carrot edition from which it is forked) is a great mod in concept, but has many issues in practice. It gives one food "diversity point" to every item, and rewards you for eating many different foods. However, because you must maintain your diet, it leads to eating many worthless foods to get your number up, like glow berries, spider eyes, rotten flesh, or even raw meat (which is the same benefit as the cooked version!). By default, Minecraft keeps entire chunks synced with players, which is problematic when using mods or data packs which make the world taller. Big Globe for example makes the overworld 2048 blocks tall. The reason why this is problematic is two-fold:
1. It means there's a lot more data to sync from the server to the client in multiplayer, which increases bandwidth requirements.
2. It means there's more blocks the client needs to keep track of, which increases memory usage.

Minecraft started delaying chunk syncing in 1.21 to adapt to the player's internet connection, and while this does help a lot,
 A lot of mods are still on MC 1.20.1, and
 The problem is still not solved completely. The player is less likely to time out now, but chunk syncing is overall slower.

I didn't find a mod that can solve all of the above problems during my brief search, so I made my own.

vitrail-shaders:
OptiFine-format shader packs, on Minecraft's native Vulkan renderer

Minecraft now ships a native Vulkan renderer alongside the OpenGL one. Every
shader pack that exists was written for OpenGL, and none of them run on it.

 Vitrail runs them anyway, unmodified. It reads an OptiFine-format pack out
of shaderpacks/ , translates its GLSL once when the pack loads, and hands it to
the compiler the game already embeds. Nothing translates while a frame is drawn.

It started as a question, whether packs written for OpenGL over more than a
decade could run untouched on the renderer that now ships with the game, and
as one person's side project, worked on every day since July. Contributors
have joined along the way, and it is still an early one: the backend it runs
on is marked experimental by the game itself.

It is built the way a lot of software gets built now, and it would not exist
otherwise:

 Overview
Databank is a library mod. It contains random, mostly rendering related libraries and utilities, as well as sound utils, data-driven multiblocks, block hiding, and music. These last three can be leveraged by modpacks if they so wish.

 Feature Highlights
Notable features may include...
 Databank Models

Databank adds its own loader for post processing shaders.

beer:
Block Entity Extended Rendering (or BEER for short) is a small mod to make block entities render from further away.

Ever been irritated that chests, banners, signs, etc. stop rendering once you get far enough away? I was, too. Though there is an entity render distance setting in vanilla Minecraft, block entities are unaffected by this setting, instead using a hard-coded 64 blocks.

BEER, however, overrides this. It provides a separate block entity render distance so that, for example, builds requiring banners are visible as intended from further away.

FoundationGames's Enhanced Block Entities mod is highly recommended as well. Note that in most cases, EBE supercedes BEER due to it baking most (but not all) block entity models into regular blocks. I mainly made this mod for banners, as well as for compatibility with mods that add new block entities.

方块实体扩展渲染（或简称BEER）是一个小的模组，使方块实体渲染从更远的地方。 你有没有因为箱子、横幅、标志等在你离开足够远的地方就停止渲染而生气过？我也是。虽然在原版的《我的世界》中有一个实体渲染距离设置，但是区方块实体不受此设置的影响，而是使用硬编码的64个区方块。 但是，BEER会覆盖此设置。它提供了一个单独的方块实体渲染距离，以便例如，需要横幅的构件可以从更远的地方看到。 FoundationGames的增强型区方块实体模组也是强烈推荐的。请注意，在大多数情况下，EBE会取代BEER，因为它会将大多数（但不是全部）区方块实体模型烘焙成常规区方块。我主要制作这个模组是为了横幅，以及与添加新区方块实体的模组兼容。

gpushift:
GpuShift

GpuShift is a client-side optimization utility for Minecraft 1.21.1.

It does not move all Minecraft CPU work to the GPU, replace the renderer, or guarantee higher FPS. Instead, it focuses on a small set of client-render tasks that can become expensive in some scenes, especially when there are many distant living entities or many cosmetic particles.

 What It Does

- Adds adaptive client-side render budgeting
- Can skip some distant non-player living entity rendering under render pressure
- Can limit newly spawned cosmetic particles based on a configurable particle budget
- Protects important visuals such as players, named entities, glowing entities, close entities, weather particles, and known compatibility cases
- Includes an optional FPS/frame-time overlay
- Adds keybinds:
 - F8 toggles the GpuShift overlay
 - F9 opens GpuShift settings
- Shows a one-time quick setup screen

createefficientgauge:
This mod does a low-hanging-fruit optimization for Create factory gauge rendering.

 Why It was Slow

Factory Gauge is a block entity, and the base mod renderer does vertex transform for gauge paths every frame. this has very high overhead considering the path is mostly unchanged across frames. Existing approaches such as createbetterfps, Flerovium does not change this immediate mode model; This mod utilizes flywheel to provide instancing support.

 Limitations

Item may have custom renderer. those item will fallback to slow path.

This mod is client only. it doesn't optimize server ticks.

This mod is ad-hoc, low-hanging fruit optimization for create factory gauge rendering. it doesn't provide a full solution to making your fps better.

This mod optimizes CPU frame time more than GPU frame time. if shader used, improvement may be small.

 Evaluation

Evaluated in controlled scenario: su

Create Slice & Dice is used together with

 Incompatibility reasons 

- Both mods inject mixins into Minecraft’s isRainingAt() method.
 Each mixin targets @At("HEAD") , uses the same priority, and is marked as cancellable .

 When multiple cancellable HEAD injections with equal priority exist, Mixin applies them sequentially in the order
 their mixin configurations are loaded. The first injected callback executes first and can cancel the method, 
 preventing later injections from running.

 In this case, Serene Seasons’ mixin configuration is resolved earlier, so its injection is applied first and cancels 
 the method. As a result, Create Slice & Dice’s injection never executes.

- Because Create Slice & Dice relies on Minecraft’s vanilla weather system to trigger rain-related sound effects,

someones-there:
Someone's There

Every so often, you'll hear a few footsteps close by. Always matching the
ground you're actually standing on. There's never anyone there.

 Features

Footsteps trigger at random intervals, from a random spot within a short
radius of you — never right on top of you, never from an impossible
location like open air.

The sound always matches the real block under it, using the same step
sounds Minecraft's own world already has for that material — dirt, stone,
wood, sand, whatever's actually there. Nothing is hardcoded to a specific
biome or setting.

Instead of a single isolated sound, each trigger plays a short sequence of
2-3 steps, spaced apart using the same walking rhythm a real player has,
with the position shifting slightly between each one — like someone
actually taking a few steps nearby, not a single sound effect going off.

A data-driven, custom cosmetics system. Originally made for BounceSMP.

 

 

 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 
 

 

 

 

 

 

BounceStyles is a cosmetics mod, designed to allow anyone to create, add, and share their own custom cosmetics into Minecraft using "Style Packs".

Using Geckolib, you can create your own Style Packs, and add cosmetics that players can unlock and equip to their Head, Body, Legs, or Feet. You can also specify a number of settings to adjust how your Style appears in game, including hiding particular player body parts or armor slots when equipped.

Players can choose what Styles to equip in their respective slots in the Wardrobe UI, accessible via Keybind, and save presets of Style combinations to reuse.

Server Admins can also create itemized versions of Styles in the form of Style Magazines to allow players to unlock particular Styles, or unlock/re-lock Styles via commands.

Sculk Sickness

A forbidden sickness is growing in the deep dark, stay away or face the consequences...

 Sculk Sickness adds a very configurable sickness effect to Minecraft. 

 How it Works
1. Sculk blossoms are a new block added in Sculk Sickness, essentially being the catalyst for the infection. They have 4 growth states, the last being the one before it spews its spores.
 
2. After becoming too close in contact when the blossom is spewing its spores or otherwise breaking the blossom you will become infected. There are 5 configurable stages with their own symptoms. Any mob can be infected unless it is a sculk entity.
 
3. To become uninfected you will have to journey and create the Ambrosia Herb. Once it is obtained, simply eat it to be cured.

4. If you are unable to be cured and die with the effect, your corpse will spread sculk and create a new blossom, thus repeating the cycle.

What does this mod do? 

This mod makes it so that you can wear the Engineer's Goggles from Create in a Curios head slot and still see the stress information overlay that you'd normally get when they're equipped in your armor head slot.

 Why is this needed? 

Newer versions of Create, mainly for Minecraft 1.18.2 and later, have support for Curios built-in. Older versions, notably those for Minecraft 1.16.5, do not. This mod aims to fill that gap.

 Frequently Asked Questions 

 Q: Aren't there other mods that do this? 

 A: Yes and no. There are other mods similar to this which either add new items which act as a helmet and the Engineer's Goggles in one or simply let you put the Engineer's Goggles in a Curios head slot. Those mods either do not integrate with other mods (e.g. they only provide vanilla helmet + Engineer's Goggles combo items) or no longer work/are not being maintained.

Create Track Map: Fork²

A live web map of your Create train network, rebuilt for scale. Same map, dramatically faster on huge networks.

 ⚠️ This is a fork of a fork. It is not the original and not AyOhEe's unofficial fork). If your network is small, just use one of those.

 Why this exists

Original CTM was built around full-state polling and a Leaflet SVG renderer. Both fall over past a few hundred track segments. This fork keeps the user-visible behaviour identical and rewrites everything underneath:

- OpenLayers canvas renderer with incremental updates
- Single SSE endpoint with delta updates instead of four full-state streams
- Train motion interpolated client-side; server polls at 1 Hz instead of 2 Hz
- Gzip on the wire, 3-decimal coords, server-side curve flattening
- Per-edge caches and a topology short-circuit so static networks cost almost nothing per tick

- Large modpacks where atlas rebuilds are expensive

subpocket:
This mod adds personal infinite storage to the game, but it is not as super-OP as it soungs though.

The subspatial pocket is a GUI that gives you a 160x70 pixels field, in which you can place and store any amount of items.

Technically, since we live in a finite world and use finite computers, you may not store true infinities of items. However in Java the maximum theoretical BigInteger value is somewhere around 2^(2^31), which is far beyond both your brain can even try to understand and your RAM to hold.

Stack in this storage can be placed at any position and dragged with your mouse.
But since your field is limited to 160x70 pixels there are enough types even in vanilla to fill all the space and make items overlap each other.
This is the main 'anti-OP' feature, you need to be accurate with your sorting or you will never find needed item.
You can test that with /subpocket help debug co

flight-kick-bypass:
Flight Kick Bypass

 

Flight Kick Bypass is a server-side mod for Minecraft.

When a player is about to be disconnected by the vanilla server for floating or flying too long, the mod first teleports the player to the top of the first solid collision block below their current position. After that, it either continues the vanilla kick flow or keeps the player online, depending on the server config.

 Why

Some modded blocks can have models or collision behavior that leave players in positions where the server repeatedly triggers the vanilla flying check. Network issues can cause similar repeated disconnects. Once this happens, the player may be kicked again immediately after reconnecting, which often requires an administrator to manually move the player or intervene through server tools.

This mod reduces that recovery work by moving the player to a valid block below them before the flyin

- 从源码构建
- 技术架构
- 致谢

---

 功能特性

 弦化

按住 Ctrl 进入弦化状态，将玩家碰撞箱压缩为薄片，降低受击面积。

- 伤害减免 ：可配置 0.0~1.0 的减伤倍率，默认减免 40%

 贴墙

弦化状态下按 R 贴附到前方墙壁上，沿墙面自由移动。

- 贴墙黑名单 ：可配置禁止贴附的方块列表

 飘飞

弦化状态下按空格键触发飘飞，在空中滑翔。

- 落地、入水、撞墙时自动取消
- 每次离地仅可飘飞一次

 多段跳

在空中按空格实现多段跳跃，默认 额外 1 段（共 2 段）。

- 每人可单独配置跳跃次数（1~N 段，或无限）
- 落地自动重置次数

 自定义碰撞箱

可视化编辑弦化和飘飞状态下的碰撞箱。

- 通用模式 ：整体偏移 + 尺寸微调
- 分体模式 ：头/身体/四肢独立配置碰撞箱
- 3D 实时预览 ：拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放

 贴墙黑名单

管理不允许贴附的方块，图形化界面操作。

- 搜索方块（支持中文名 / 命名空间 ID）
- 左键点击切换禁用状态
- 分享/导入 ：一键生成压缩分享码，跨存档还原黑名单

 玩家描边

给指定玩家添加发光描边，方便在人群中定位。支持 16 种颜色。

This is a small mod that allows creating aliases for commands.

Beginning with 1.20.1 you can now also inline replace arguments.

Control Nether portal linking with colored glazed terracotta corner markers.

 About This Fork

This is an updated and optimized fork of the original https://modrinth.com/mod/corner-portal-linking by starbidou. All credit for the original concept and implementation goes to them. This fork brings the mod to Minecraft 1.21 with performance improvements.

 What It Does

This mod helps you tell the game how Nether portals in the same area should connect. Instead of relying on unpredictable vanilla portal linking, you can create unique "signatures" for your portals using glazed terracotta blocks.

 How It Works

It's really simple:

1. Place glazed terracotta at the four corners of your portal to create a pattern

Not Enough Potatoes
 Potato Armor

Potato Armor tracks potatoes eaten, improving its protection.

 
 Recipes

Potato Shard let's any armor in the game track potatoes eaten, gaining extra armor. Right Click to apply it to one of the equipped armor items.

 Automation

Use a dispenser armed with potatoes (baked and poisonous work as well) on an armor stand wearing valid armor or just stand before it yourself.

 Armor Increase Formula

 Armor Extra Protection 
 -------- -------- 
 Potato armor 7/3 ln(x) 
 Other 7/3 ln(x) / ln(6)

Simple Tree Harvester

A lightweight Fabric mod that lets you chop down entire trees in one go. Simply sneak and break a log with an axe, and the whole tree will fall from top to bottom.

 How It Works

When you break a log while sneaking, the mod automatically detects the rest of the tree — trunk and foliage — and breaks it cleanly, passing player data for every block. This means compatibility with enchantments, drops, advancements, and other mods that rely on player interactions.

 Why This Mod?

Most tree harvesters skip small step: they don’t pass player context when breaking blocks.
This mod fixes that. Every block broken behaves as if the player did it themselves, ensuring better mod compatibility and a more consistent experience.

 Configuration

- maxLogs : Maximum "Logs" that can be in a tree 128 by default 
- maxFoliage : Maximum "Foliage" that can be in a tree 512 by default

Structural Safety

 Protect structures and world-generation features without changing how Minecraft feels. 

Structural Safety is a fully server-side protection system for Minecraft structures and world-generation features. Players remain in Survival Mode , while protected areas automatically control what they may break, place and interact with.

Allowed blocks still use normal Vanilla mining mechanics — including mining speed, tools, durability, enchantments, drops and events.

 No client mod is required. 

---

 ✨ What Structural Safety Does

When players enter a protected structure or feature, Structural Safety automatically applies the rules configured for that area.

Players can still:

 Fight mobs normally
 Loot chests and containers
 Break specifically allowed blocks using normal Vanilla mining
 Use tools, enchantments and durability normally
 Interact with permitted blocks
 Place

CRM (CometRenderer Mod) is a library that provides various utilities for using CometRenderer within Minecraft.

 Whats CometRenderer?
CometRenderer is an optimized, customized and full independent rendering system for OpenGL. This provides a wide range of tools that can be used to easily render your projects.

In the context of Minecraft, its main feature is that over 80% of all rendering code will be identical for all versions of Minecraft for which there is a CRM. This means that when you port your mod from one Minecraft version to another, almost all of the rendering-related code will remain identical.

 Documentation
The project has documentation that contains various information about using CometRenderer and CRM.

 FAQ
 Can it replace Sodium or Optifine?
No. CRM provides an various utilities for using CometRenderer in Minecraft, without changing Minecraft's rendering.

mediumcore-fix:
Mediumcore Fix

 Fixes health data loss when updating Alex's Mediumcore mod 

 
 

---

 Problem
The original Mediumcore in onLivingDeath uses player.getMaxHealth(), which INCLUDES modifiers from external sources (rings, armor, etc.).

Example with a +20 HP ring:

- maxHealth = 40 (20 base + 20 ring) 
- clippedHealth = clip(40 - 2, 6, 20) = 20 (clamped to maxPlayerHealth!)
- healthModifiedBy = 0 + (20 - 40) = -20!
- After respawn: maxHealth = 20 + 0 + (-20) = 0 HP → the player gains 1 HP.

 Solution
Introduce BASE HEALTH TAG to store the "pure" base health, which is independent of external modifiers.

pathwright:
Pathwright

 Mob pathfinding optimization for Minecraft 26.1.2. 

Pathwright targets one of the most expensive hot-paths in Minecraft's server loop: mob pathfinding. Every mob that wants to move somewhere has to compute a path — and in vanilla, every single one of those calculations happens on the main server thread, one after another. Pathwright replaces that with a three-layer optimization system. Every layer is independently toggleable, so you can disable anything that conflicts with another mod in a single config line.

---

 Summary

The Pathwright mod makes mob pathfinding faster by computing paths smarter. Instead of recalculating every mob's path every tick on the main thread, Pathwright caches paths that have already been computed, offloads path updates to background threads, and slows down path recalculation for mobs that are far away from any player. This keeps your TPS higher

Intro :This datapack is designed to modify the rendering logic of projectiles in the game. When paired with the "Blue Crystal" data package, it will be extra effective.

The principle is very simple: the best distance to clear the projectile is obtained by testing the actual maximum rendering distance reached by the projectile on the real machine. In Minecraft, some projectiles freeze in the air after a certain distance to enhance performance. Although this can indeed improve performance, it has been found that projectiles do not disappear on their own after reaching the farthest rendering distance. This datapack is designed to fill this gap, and projectiles and items dropped on the ground will be cleared after exceeding the player's field of view.

Drone Logistics

Automated item delivery between your storages using flying delivery drones. Built for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1.

 Overview

Drone Logistics turns hauling resources between bases into an automated task. Instead of running chests back and forth, you build a network of terminals, attach storages and a drone to them, and order the items you need. A drone then flies to the other storage, picks up the cargo and brings it back to you.

 Core parts

- Logistics Terminal. A control block where you browse your storages, place orders and collect deliveries.
- Linking Tool. Used to select a storage area (any chests and containers inside it) and to attach the storage and the drone to a terminal.
- Delivery Drone. A flying entity that physically travels from your terminal to the target storage and back.

 How to play

This allows you to brew potions by moving a potion icon around a map of effects. Every ingredient pushes the potion along a fixed path. This mod adds an endpoint for the postion data of the create trains. To install simply place the jar file into the mods folder. By default it uses port 8080, this can be changed in the config file. 

 BlueMap overlay

To show trains, tracks, stations, signals and portals on the map, copy train.js into BlueMap's webroot (e.g. bluemap/web/ ), set host at the top of the file to the address of this API as seen from the browser, and add it to the scripts in BlueMap's webapp.conf :
 
scripts: [
 "./train.js"
]

Overview
This is a performance modpack with a philosophy of focusing on accessibility and avoiding invasive changes. That said, you may notice a few things that differ from vanilla:

What is Better Caps & why does it exist?
Well for one simple reason - I don't like the flat 2D brims on the original models. I don't know how but I always manage to look at it head on - making the brim disappear entirely, which gives the model a rater interesting look. Then I remembered that RedRibbon made a better cap for her PokeCostumes addon - which didn't work with the new 1.7 models. I took that as a challenge, ported the cap to the new Pikachu model and gave it loooots of retexturing to turn one cap into 9!

 How to install:
 
 Click for instructions! 

As of v1.1 this addon is both a data and resource pack so you need to install it as both. It will still work without the datapack installed but you won't be able to obtain the Partner Pikachu. 
 Singleplayer:
 Put the .zip in /saves/[WORLDNAME]/datapacks 
 Put the .zip in /resourcepacks 
 Enable in game ESC - Options - Resource Pac

什么是更好的瓶盖？为什么会有更好的瓶盖？ 原因很简单--我不喜欢原版模特的平面2D帽檐。我不知道怎么做到的，但我总是能直视它--让帽檐完全消失，这让模特看起来更有趣。然后我想起RedRibbon为她的PokeCostumes插件做了一个更好的帽子--这在新的1.7版模特身上不起作用。我把它当作一个挑战。把帽子移植到新的皮卡丘模型上，并给它做了大量的重新材质处理，把一个帽子变成了9个！ 安装方法： 从v1.1开始，这个插件既是一个数据包，也是一个资源包，所以你需要同时安装它。它在没有安装数据包的情况下仍然可以工作，但是你将无法获得合作伙伴皮卡丘。 单人游戏： 将.zip文件放入/saves/[WORLDNAME]/数据包中 将.zip文件放在/resourcepacks中 在游戏中启用ESC -选项-资源包 Enable in game ESC - Options - Resource Pac

Depth-Based Creeper Griefing
I always disliked how the vanilla options for managing Creepers was either on or off, especially in multiplayer. And /gamerule mobGriefing is excessively heavy-handed for my tastes. Initially, I was inspired by a datapack that made creepers only do block damage below sea level, but support was dropped due to lack of interest. I ran with this idea - what if Creeper danger was based on y-level?

 Features
- Creepers at or above sea level only do mob damage, and do not damage blocks (Keeps typical player chests and builds safe)
- Creepers in the Deepslate layer have increased potency and inflict Mining Fatigue on explosion, hampering your escape. This should help them be more dangerous "support enemies"

 Thanks to:

mtr4-twr-70-000-series:
A resource pack for Minecraft Transit Railway. 

 Overview
The Tokyo Waterfront Area Rapid Transit 70-000 series are trains produced by Kawasaki between 1995 and 2004. A total of 86 vehicles are produced for the TWR Rinkai Line, and through services to JR Saikyō and Kawagoe Lines. These trains use the 209 series as the base, as a measure to reduce production and maintenance costs (maintenance of these trains is carried out by JR East). 
6 vehicles are transferred to JR East and reclassified as "209-3100" for Hachikō and Kawagoe Lines as a result of reforming all units to 10-car trains.
These trains are retiring from service gradually and some will be transferred to JR Kyushu to replace the 103 series that are still running on the Chikuhi line.

This resource pack is to add the TWR 70-000 series into Minecraft with Minecraft Transit Railway mod, made by Navi LX9702 in 2025.

 Disclaimer

Stripped Fences uses the stripped log model on fences and fence gates. They look clean!

 26.3 Woods

This pack supports the Poplar fence items introduced in 26.3.

 Compatibility

This pack only changes models, it contains no textures, but reuses the stripped wood log textures. If another pack modify these textures, the fences will also be updated accordingly.

 Why this rather than Vanilla Tweaks?

This pack uses the stripped wood texture, which is still a lot less noisy than what Vanilla Tweaks did by rotating the plank textures. It may also be more compatible in combination with other resource packs.

british-rail-classes-507-and-508:
A resource pack for Minecraft Transit Railway. 

 Overview
The British Rail Class 507/508 are Third-rail EMUs produced by British Rail Engineering Limited between 1978 and 1980. They are a member of BREL's 1972 design suburban trains, the others being Class 313, 314 and 315. Class 507 is "designed for Merseyside" after proven to be "suitable" to be used (initially on the Northern Line) after a test carried out by 2 Class 313 units. Class 508 however is originally used in London (they are also designed for Merseyside), then are all transferred to Merseyrail and reclassified to Class 508/1 and have 1 of their TSO coach removed and used on Class 455/7s instead. Some are leased to Southeastern and London Overground in the 2000s, which are later scrapped without returning to Merseyrail. Class 507 initially worked on the Northern Line and Class 508 on the Wirral Line, but they now work on both

Smooth8x

Smooth8x is a texture pack created for the purpose of improving performance for low-end computers or for someone who wants to experience Minecraft in a new way.

 How does it improve performance?

Smooth8x works by having textures scaled to an 8x8 format instead of the default 16x16. This reduces the consumption of VRAM (Video Random Access Memory), which can lead to better performance or even higher FPS (Frames Per Second) if your GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) is old or does not have a lot of VRAM.

1. First, download the texture pack for your Minecraft version.
2. Next, move the .zip file out of your downloads folder, and place it into the "resourcepacks" folder.
3. After that, launch your game and navigate to: "Options - Resourcepacks" and enable the texture pack.
4. Enjoy the texture pack!

As of 1.20.5, the old obfuscation methods for ogg files, which are required in order to host C418's music in Modrinth and CurseForge projects, no longer work. The only way around this is with a compressed, obfuscated zip file - which cannot be redistributed in mods.

As a result, this project was created as a standalone addon to re-add C418 music formerly used in Legacies and Legends, Wilder Wild and Music and Melody.

In order to use this resouce pack, you must extract only the first zip, and then place the resource pack zip found within into your resource packs folder, as you normally would.

Make sure to place this RP above the resource packs provided by the aforementioned projects.

You may use this project within Modrinth modpacks.

This project provides a resource package that converts the source strings of Minecraft: Java Edition language files into Katakanas and Man'yōganas, and converts Simplified Chinese into Pinyin, Bopomofo and IPA.

Please use the mod Modern UI to make the game support modern font features to ensure that all characters are displayed normally.

It is recommended to use this resource pack with the mods Language Reload and Untranslated Items.

For more details, see the README on GitHub Repository.

 Languages

The resource pack added 15 languages into the game:

- "i18nglish (i7h)" ( en i7h.json )
 - Once selected, all strings will be changed to abbreviations with the first and last characters of the English word retained and the number of characters in the middle replaced. Words with a length of 2 or less will remain unchanged.
- "エングリスホ (カタカナ)" ( ja kk.json )
 - i.e. "English (Katakana)".
 -

Azka 3D - Spyglass
A resourcepack that improves the in-hand model of the spyglass by adding a bit more detail to it.
 Azka 3D Collection
This pack is part of Azka 3D collection of resourcepacks, all of which follow the same design principles:
- Vanilla+ - Models are modified to improve their level of detail, add depth and sometimes make other changes, while being mostly faithful to the vanilla. Indents and extrusions are either 1 or 0.5 pixel in height, matching the style of vanilla blocks.
- No flickering - To prevent Z-fighting (texture flickering), elements extending beyond the block boundary are marginally offset. Models do not use extrusions along their edges to prevent Z-fighting with potential extrusions of other diagonally placed models.
- Optimization - The resourcepacks makes use of custom textures and transparency, to keep the polygon count as low as possible.

rotbar:
Adds yaw, pitch, fog end, and fog color information to the right side\ of the hotbar.

The topmost number is yaw in degrees and ranges from -179.99 to 180.00. 
The middle number is pitch in degrees and ranges from -90.00 to 90.00. 
The bottom number is fog end distance in blocks.

There is a compass beside the yaw number which can indicate cardinal directions (N E S W) and ordinal directions (NE NW SE SW). Up is north.

There is an indicator which displays whether you are looking up or down beside the pitch number.

The fog color can be found beside the fog end distance number.

 \ Since all information is presented on the right side, your main hand should be right for the best experience.

Mode 13h: MS-DOSify!

 An Iris shader pack for Minecraft that recreates the look of late-90s MS-DOS 3D graphics with deliberate retro accuracy. 

 

 Mode 13h: MS-DOSify! is not just a generic “pixelation” shader. It aims to reproduce the actual visual limitations and quirks that gave old DOS-era 3D games their unmistakable look: low resolution, wobbly software texture mapping, a fixed 256-color palette, colormap lighting, billboarded sprites, and vanilla-accurate fog.

It supports the long-term Minecraft versions 1.20.1 , 1.21.1 and 1.21.11 with Iris or Oculus ; every release is tested on all three. 26.x and other versions are best-effort .

 Recommended render resolution: 1280 x 800 
 The shader pack is designed to downscale by 4x to an internal 320 x 200 image, matching classic Mode 13h output. 
 For the most authentic look, stretch the final image to 4:3 to reproduce the era’s non-sq

Photon Engine — Next-Generation Voxel Ray Tracing for Minecraft

 Experience Minecraft in a completely new light. 

Photon Engine is an advanced, experimental shaderpack designed to push Minecraft Java Edition's graphics to the next level. Combining voxel-based ray tracing, global illumination, realistic reflections, physically based atmospheric rendering, and advanced lighting simulation , Photon Engine aims to bring a cinematic, RTX-inspired visual experience to Minecraft.

Unlike traditional screen-space-only shaders, Photon Engine uses a voxel representation of the surrounding world to simulate lighting and reflections beyond what is currently visible on screen.

 Key Features

 Advanced Ray-Traced Lighting
- Voxel-based Global Illumination (GI) with multiple light bounces

Introduction

 What is this plugin?

 AdvancePlHide is a plugin designed to control what the client can see when using tab-completion.

This kind of functionality isn’t widely available in the plugin ecosystem—so this plugin was created to fill that gap.

It doesn’t just hide plugin:command entries from the tab list; it also blocks plugin completions from showing up after
commands like /ver (try it on your server without this plugin and watch your plugin list!).

The plugin also gives you full control over which commands are visible to clients, so your plugins don’t accidentally
expose themselves. 
You can specify a list of visible commands or block specific ones from showing up.
 Note: This only affects tab-completion—it does not prevent commands from being executed.

 Features

- Group-based architecture; compatible with any permission manager.
- Hides plugin lists from common commands
